scenario: Regional VP Approver lookup ambiguity: combobox lookup candidate versus plain text input candidate

decision.kept: MCP-style context planner as the primary LLM-context path for locator healing
decision.fallback: If context planning fails, returns no section, requests malformed input, or selects a whole document, Neo falls back to base metadata + DOM ranking.
decision.reason: The corrected planner selected a bounded page section directly about field behavior, added citable intent evidence, preserved the same candidate choice, and did not widen the model's selectable candidates. Broad context was proven risky and is now ignored unless a named section is selected. The planner is now incremental: if the first bounded section does not produce an intent-cited, high-confidence final ranking with contextAssessment.intentFit=SUFFICIENT, Neo provides compact prior-context and previous-ranking summaries to request one additional named section before stopping.

runs.assessment: Accurate and stable on this easy metadata-rich case, but has no business intent citation.
Correct candidate, but selected broad persona/governance context. This validated the user's noise concern and was not accepted as final design.

Correct candidate with relevant bounded page-behavior context and citable intent evidence. Confidence is slightly lower than base on this simple case, but robustness and traceability improve without changing candidate choice.

Real provider smoke passed after launching with inherited provider variables cleared so .env was the single provider source. The planner fetched a narrow field-behavior section first, continued because the first ranking was not sufficient, fetched a second bounded page-elements section, and accepted only after the final proposal reported intentFit=SUFFICIENT.

Functional test proves Neo does not stop when the first ranking reports contextAssessment.intentFit=PARTIAL and missingContext=PAGE_FLOW. It fetches the second real knowledge-repo section and accepts only after the final ranking reports SUFFICIENT with an intent citation.

guardrails: Provider-native tool calls remain disabled; the model emits a strict JSON tool plan and Neo executes the bounded MCP-style tool.
Only knowledge_section is currently available to the planner.
knowledge_section arguments must include page, module, impact and section keys; exactly one selector is a string and section must name a heading for planner-originated context.
Whole-document planner requests are ignored to avoid adding broad or noisy context.
If planning fails, final ranking still runs on metadata plus DOM candidates.
Final model output can still choose only an existing candidate ordinal; context never grants selector-writing authority.
Incremental expansion is capped at two planner attempts and sends only compact prior-context and previous-ranking summaries; it never repeats a fetched section or escalates to whole-document context.

The final locator proposal schema requires contextAssessment.intentFit, missingContext and reason. Neo treats PARTIAL, INSUFFICIENT and NOT_PROVIDED as insufficient grounding when incremental context was fetched, so confidence alone cannot prematurely stop the loop.
Manual/provider smoke runs must use scripts/run/run-locator-healing-smoke.ps1 or otherwise clear inherited provider variables; Settings must continue blocking conflicting process/.env credentials.
